propositions: Duplicate CAS delivery loops in workflows and library code were consolidated into a single Python core owner at src/rebar/_store/push.py with strict and best-effort modes.

The strict push entrypoint enforces a five-cycle retry budget, fetch-and-merge recovery, and raises PushDeliveryError with typed failure reasons; the strict commit-and-push entrypoint locks the tree and stages atomically.
Workflow adapters (reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary) now delegate delivery once to Python strict-mode entrypoints instead of maintaining local git retry loops.
Legacy Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers preserve best-effort defaults with no return-contract changes; strictness is opt-in and keyword-only.
Exhausted strict delivery produces nonzero adapter exit and visible GitHub Actions failure; local commits remain recoverable for retry after remote or policy issues are corrected.
